description:
The programme commenced at 10:45 am with an introduction by Rtn. Sharmendra, followed by a floral welcome to the speaker by Rtn. Bhuvana Kumar.
Advocate Dayanand Shetty conducted an informative seminar on property transfer procedures, legal requirements and the importance of making a Will. Through practical examples and real-life case studies, he explained property transmission to legal heirs and how the absence of a Will can lead to lengthy legal procedures.
Key topics covered:
Eligibility and requirements for making a Will.
Assets covered under a Will.
Rights of legal heirs and nominees.
Property distribution in different family situations.
Legal validity and essential elements of a Will.
Guidelines for drafting a clear and simple Will.
The seminar concluded with an interactive Q&A session, with approximately 20–30 questions from participants on nominations, insurance, property transfers, society procedures and investments.
The programme concluded with a vote of thanks and felicitation of the speaker, followed by tea and delicious snacks prepared by Rtn. Shrance.
